links.outcome: LLM diagnostic performance differences across 6 psychiatric centers
links.effect: Model performance remained stable across centers, with no significant intercenter differences.
links.quote: Across centers, model performance remained stable, with no significant intercenter differences.

links.outcome: LLM diagnostic accuracy across age subgroups
links.effect: Accuracy varied by age group: highest in older adults (up to 79.5%), lower in adolescents.
links.quote: Diagnostic performance varied across age groups, with the highest accuracy observed in older adult patients (up to 79.5%) and lower accuracy in adolescents.

screen.reason: Retrospective multicenter evaluation comparing the diagnostic accuracy of three commercial LLMs on inpatient electronic health records without testing specific deployment safeguards or clinical workflows.
